digest.component_or_area: Tickets-branch delivery and CAS push mechanics
propositions: Duplicate CAS push/retry loops across workflows are consolidated into a single Python core module (src/rebar/_store/push.py) that owns fetch-and-merge recovery, five-cycle retry budget, and terminal push logic.

Strict delivery mode is implemented as an opt-in keyword parameter that raises PushDeliveryError with stable typed reasons; best-effort defaults are preserved for existing library, CLI, MCP, and importer callers.

Workflow orchestration is decoupled from delivery mechanics: reconcile-bridge and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows now delegate exactly once to Python entrypoints instead of containing their own fetch/merge/retry loops.
The private python -m rebar._store.push adapter translates core failures to stderr and nonzero exit status while keeping core functions reusable and free of sys.exit calls.
